expressions.title: The Martial Law (Pending Proceedings) Order, 1972
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 2019308-2019309 print 'THE MARTIAL LAW (PENDING PROCEEDINGS) ORDER, 1972 / PRESIDENT'S ORDER No. 14 OF 1972'; it ends on p3 at article 7 and the signatures (block 2019355 'Secretary'). Blocks 2019356 onward (p3) begin the Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972 (President's Order No. 15 of 1972) and stop at its article 3(c) -- a fragment of a law the corpus holds complete and released as document 1776 -- so they are set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split': a bound law already held complete is not duplicated from a fragment).
